'''Primitive Sentient Protection and Alliance, Operation 265-A: Karra''' was the designation of an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] mission to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Karra]] to broker an alliance with the native [[Karran]]. It was headed by [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Elth Nardah]], and assisted by [[Karvinna Raen]] and a team of Alliance agents.<ref name="Stranded" /> Once on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], the agents protected Nardah as he evaluated the native [[Karran]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="TCSWE">{{CSWECite|II|415|Operation 265-A}}</ref>
